branch_reason: Prior supplier worst violation 0.0630079 is smaller than author 0.0716534; complete independently sourced Merck YbF3 n/k retained as the more absorptive stress branch. Results are conditional on this branch only.
original_constraints: Single front coating on semi-infinite bulk Querry ZnS, unpolarized HR>=99% on580-920 and1044-1084nm, AR strictly<3% on3000-5000 and7000-12000nm,39-51deg;5nm minimum;64layer cap;no user thickness caps.
training: Every trial evaluates all 95992 wavelength-angle samples:1nm inclusive wavelengths,13angles39..51deg. Full coherent joint optics, source complex n+ik, no extrapolation.

budget.optical_call_cancel_boundary: checked between all52 objective-angle kernel calls; a late cancelled incomplete trial is not archived
budget.search: sequential serial CPU with math threads1; initialization plus all stages charged to family. Setup and independent replay/report separately timed.

stages.name: architecture_beta64
stages.coordinates: 10 HR center/material shared multiplicative phase scales plus independent IR thicknesses

guide: L-BFGS-B with exact analytic production optical thickness Jacobians and chain rule. Loss=(1/beta)log(sum_i sum_j exp(beta*v_ij)/(4*N_i)), v=lower-R forHR or R-upper forAR. Equal window mass is only a search guide, never acceptance. Archive lexicographic original maximum positive violation then per-window-averaged squared positive violation.
research_bounds: Shared HR scales[0.65,1.45] relative to cold seed; each IR physical layer[5nm,2.5*cold_thickness]. All-layer stages recenter d0 +/- 0.5 quarter-wave using550nm forHR or6000nm forIR, intersect5nm minimum. These are declared finite search boxes, not user/manufacturing limits.
replay: Independent normal prepared evaluator,1nm25angles0.5deg,unpolarized and s/p diagnostics for every final family; reproduce training values on best and compare prior failed candidate. If a training pass, complete production0.1nm+shift/extrema audit and25angleindependent check before any acceptance claim. Failed seeds get no large production audit.
stopping: All six200second family slices completed or solver stages returned early; no broad time extension. A bounded negative is not infeasibility. No software repository edit or publication.
warm_start_policy: No warm starts in this frozen experiment. Any later continuation must be separately labelled and budgeted.
